>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/process-capacities"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Upserts one named constraint (LABOR, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT, STATION, CONVEYOR, BUFFER or REPLENISHMENT) on the ProcessCapacity identified by (process_type, location, window_start, window_end), creating the aggregate on first registration. Returns the recomputed effective rate (the minimum across every registered constraint) and which constraint is binding. The window is the aggregate's identity: this endpoint (like GET /process-capacities) uses EXACT-key semantics. When path capacity or a capacity plan is computed, a registered window applies to the requested planning window if it COVERS it (docs/adr/0003).

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters, normally a UUID) per LOGICAL submit. A retry reuses it; a new user action mints a new one. The service always runs against Postgres (ADR 0016), so the key is required on every POST/PATCH. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 idempotency-key-reused; the same key with the same request replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
